_comment: Maps the exact label text from the sheet's 'Species' dropdown to a species.json slug. Edited by hand — see docs/data-pipeline.md. A null value means the label is ambiguous or has no matching species.json entry, so the importer routes it to data/import-review.json instead of guessing. A label may instead map to a genus-level 'rank: genus' entry (e.g. 'Bottlenose' -> bottlenose-dolphin, Tursiops sp.) when the dropdown can't distinguish species that are indistinguishable in the field — that is not a guess, it publishes the row at the precision the recorder actually chose. resolve_species() in scripts/import_sightings.py still prefers a specific scientific name typed in the sheet's notes column over the genus bucket, and still refuses to guess for a null-mapped label.
